label: I q.26 a.2: Divine beatitude consists in the act of understanding
locator: I q.26 a.2 co. and ad 2
interpretation: The body says that the beatitude of every created intellectual nature consists in understanding, then gives God's case through the real identity of being and understanding. The second reply locates beatitude in the act of intellect and the will's resting in it as object.
attribution: The passage states that God possesses beatitude in the act of intellect, which in him is really identical with his being and is the object in which his will rests, which is the premise.
